title: The Heavenly Eye Emerges
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji stepped out of the secret realm, the Heavenly Eye released a furious declaration: 'Next time we meet, I will take your life.' And in the depths of Tianqing Sect, far away, Ling Yuan, who had kept his eyes tightly shut for years, also opened them at this moment.

text.content: That giant eye covering the heavens slowly turned, and within its pupil's depths, galaxies seemed to sink and float. Every blink stirred the world's elemental energy into chaotic tides. Chen Ji stood at the entrance of the secret realm, gazing up at that eye spanning the horizon, feeling a pressure unlike any he had ever experienced—not crushing pressure, but a negation of his very existence, as if Heaven was examining an ant that dared to shake a tree, ready to erase him from the river of destiny at any moment.

dialogue.content: "Wretched insect." The voice came from all directions simultaneously, both by his ears and in his heart. "What do you think you're holding? The Tianji Record? It's merely a piece in my grand scheme spanning ten thousand years. And you—even a piece doesn't qualify. You're just dust kicked up by a piece."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, and the Tianji Record Fragment within him vibrated frantically, seemingly responding to the Heavenly Eye's pressure. He forcibly suppressed the churning qi and blood, a faint smile tugging at the corner of his lips. It hurt, it truly hurt, but this pain反而让他清醒——the more urgently the Heavenly Eye wanted to crush him, the more correct his path must be.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, Outer Disciple/Servant of Tianqing Sect, trash constitution with three spiritual roots." The voice began to pronounce judgment. "Your fate was supposed to be exhausted at thirty-seven, dying alone in a枯井 on the Rear Mountain. Yet now you dare to use the fragmented Tianji Record to peer into Heavenly Secrets and rewrite karma—how ridiculous." The giant eye's pupil slightly contracted, and an invisible force suddenly pressed down.

text.content: Chen Ji's knees buckled violently, the ground cracking and sinking three inches. He clenched his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, but he did not kneel. Thirty-seven years old, dying alone in a well—was this the destiny Heaven wrote for him? Fine, he记下了. After he rewrote his fate, he'd like to see what expression the Heavenly Eye would make.

He slowly raised his hand, and a warm jade pendant hidden in his sleeve quietly shattered. That was a life-saving item Mo Xiansheng gave him before his departure—a 'Tianji Concealment Talisman,' usable for only three breaths. Three breaths were enough. In an instant, Chen Ji's aura completely disappeared from the Heavenly Eye's perception. The giant eye's pupil contracted violently, seemingly startled that this ant had escaped its lock.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's gaze and judgment, Chen Ji must make a choice—endure and lie low, or declare war face-to-face?

choices.description: "My fate, I write myself." Declare a oath to change destiny before all, letting the Heavenly Eye witness.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amounts of spiritual power
choices.risk_hint: May incur more intense Heavenly backlash

text.content: Before the jade talisman's shattered light faded, Chen Ji suddenly raised his head,直视那只高高在上的巨眼. "Thirty-seven years old, dying alone in a well?" His voice echoed between heaven and earth. "Then let the junior tell the senior—from today forward, my life is determined by me, not Heaven."

dialogue.content: "If Heaven wants me to die? I'll live just to spite you!"

choices.description: "The senior is right, the junior is merely dust." Feign weakness on the surface, secretly activate new ability of Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: May be completely locked onto by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, his voice reaching the extreme of humility. "What the senior said is absolutely correct. How would I, merely a grain of dust, dare to contend with Heaven." The Heavenly Eye slightly narrowed, seemingly satisfied by his sensible response. However, in that instant, the fingers hidden in Chen Ji's sleeve had already quietly formed a seal, and the Tianji Record Fragment frantically operated within his body—he was gambling, gambling that this eye's arrogance would make it lower its guard.

choices.description: "The junior is willing to exchange this fragment for—" Pretend to hand over the Tianji Record, actually delay and wait for reinforcements.
choices.visible_cost: Must sacrifice Tianji Record Fragment as bait
choices.risk_hint: May be directly taken by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: A trace of struggle flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, then transformed into resolve. "Since the senior wants this fragment, the junior—" He made a motion to take the object from his chest. The Heavenly Eye's pupil suddenly contracted, a greedy intention piercing through that layer of arrogance. However, in that instant, the communication jade slip hidden in Chen Ji's sleeve slightly warmed—someone was coming.

The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then released a laughter that shook the azure dome. "Rewrite fate?" The laughter was full of contempt. "For ten thousand years, how many brilliant talents tried to break free from my chessboard, ultimately becoming nothing but sighs in the dust of history. Do you think this fragmented Tianji Record can give you anything? It's merely waste paper I personally tore apart back then—"

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment within Chen Ji suddenly erupted with unprecedented light. That light was as brilliant as a galaxy overturned, instantly breaking through the Heavenly Eye projection's suppression, condensing into a虚幻的书页 before Chen Ji—the seal of the Tianji Record's Fifth Layer, awakening automatically at this moment.

An ancient voice rang in Chen Ji's mind—that was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "It didn't lie. The Tianji Record truly was torn apart by Heaven—because the First Generation Prophet tried to use it to counterattack Heaven. But it miscalculated one thing—" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a smile. "Who the fragments fell into the hands of."

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" For the first time, a tremor appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice. "How could that waste—" Its pupil疯狂收缩, and a world-destroying thunder was brewing within its eyelid. However, the Fifth Layer awakening light had already enveloped Chen Ji, and he felt unprecedented power circulating within him.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his consciousness pulled into a vast star sea. Countless points of light flowed before his eyes—that was the content unlocked by the Tianji Record's Fifth Layer—'Heavenly Fate Reversal': when the host makes an unbreakable oath, they can briefly bind their own karma with the target, causing the other's fate prophecy to deviate. Simply put, it made Heaven's eye—see inaccurately.

"Good, very good." The Heavenly Eye's voice turned ice-cold. "Since you chose this path, I shall grant you your wish." Deep within the giant eye's pupil, a jet-black thunder slowly condensed—that was Heavenly Punishment sufficient to destroy an entire nation. "If you can withstand this strike, I will acknowledge you have the qualification to sit at this chessboard. If you cannot—ashes to ashes."

choice.prompt: Heavenly Punishment is about to descend. Chen Ji must choose how to respond—face the strike head-on or seek another method?

choices.description: Activate Fifth Layer new ability 'Heavenly Fate Reversal,' forcibly collide with Heavenly Punishment.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amounts of Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, both hands suddenly forming a seal. "I, Chen Ji, swear by Heavenly Fate—" His voice echoed through the star sea. "From this day forward, Heaven's First Prophecy is null and void!" The Tianji Record Fifth Layer blazed brilliantly, colliding violently with that jet-black thunder in mid-air. Blinding light swallowed everything. Chen Ji felt every inch of his skin burning.

But he did not retreat. The Heavenly Punishment's thunder gradually dissipated in the light, while Chen Ji's figure stood proudly. His robes were completely destroyed, scorch marks covered his body, but those eyes—brighter than ever before. "The First Prophecy—" he slowly spoke, voice hoarse yet firm. "Is null and void."

choices.description: Use Tianji Record's foresight ability, precisely find the flaw in Heavenly Punishment, resolve with minimal cost.
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by Heaven's intent

text.content: Chen Ji did not choose to clash head-on. The Tianji Record rapidly operated in his mind, those three hours of foresight ability frantically capturing the thunder's falling trajectory. He saw it—there was a tiny crack in the thunder's northeast corner, the instant flaw when Heavenly Punishment condensed. "Found it." A slight smile curved his lips as his figure flickered like a ghost.

choices.description: Delay to wait for reinforcements, jointly resolve this strike.
choices.visible_reward: Fight shoulder to shoulder with allies

text.content: Chen Ji did not move. Not that he didn't want to, but that he couldn't—he sensed two familiar auras rapidly approaching. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist and Su Qingyao's sword intent, tearing apart the secret realm's barrier from left and right. "Chen Ji!" Ye Qing's voice carried urgency. "We're here!"

Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist swept over like a black rainbow, instantly fragmenting the Heavenly Eye's lock. She floated in the air, and between the surrounding demonic energy, a rare hint of solemnity appeared on that enchanting face. "Chen Ji, you really know how to make trouble." Though she verbally reproached, a jet-black long blade had already condensed in her hand. "This kind of thing—there are records in my Holy Sect's ancient texts."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao arrived on her sword, sword light sharp as frost. Her gaze swept across that giant eye, her expression slightly changing, but her hand gripped the sword even tighter. "The Heavenly Eye's projection... what did you do to attract this thing?" However, her body had already instinctively moved to Chen Ji's side, sword intent and demonic energy interweaving into a unique barrier.

text.content: The three stood shoulder to shoulder. Facing the Heavenly Eye's pressure sufficient to destroy a nation, their backs seemed so tiny, yet so steadfast. Ye Qing coldly laughed: "Heaven? Hmph, my Demonic Path has dealt with your so-called Heaven for ten thousand years, and I've never feared anyone." The Demonic Path mist around her surged wildly. "Chen Ji, what do we do?"

choice.prompt: Reinforcements have arrived. The three face off against the Heavenly Eye projection. Chen Ji must make the final decision—fight or retreat?

choices.description: "Let's go together! Let it know we're not easy targets!" The three launch a joint attack.
choices.visible_reward: Give the Heavenly Eye a profound lesson
choices.process_label: 三人联手攻击天道投影

text.content: A decisive light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. "Listen to my command—Ye Qing, your Demonic Path mist harasses from the left flank; Su Senior Sister, sword intent strikes directly at the pupil's core; I'll hold its attention." This was the first time he issued orders in battle, yet the two executed without hesitation.

Three attacks erupted simultaneously. The Demonic Path mist coiled like venomous serpents, demonic energy and sword light weaving into a great net, rushing straight for the Heavenly Eye's pupil. The Heavenly Eye clearly hadn't expected these three "ants" to dare attack proactively. A flash of astonishment crossed its pupil, followed by fury.

choices.description: "Retreat first. It's merely a projection. We have no need to fight this out." Preserve strength, settle accounts later.
choices.risk_hint: May be despised by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: "Retreat." Chen Ji's decision was干脆利落. "It's a projection. We have no need to exhaust ourselves here." Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged a glance. Though doubtful, they chose to trust him. The three身形暴退, Demonic Path mist and sword light forming cover, instantly withdrawing from the Heavenly Eye's attack range.

The Heavenly Eye's pupil violently contracted, and a jet-black thunder crashed down. However, Chen Ji was prepared. The Tianji Record Fifth Layer's ability activated again, and that thunder eerily deflected three feet away from him, striking empty ground. "Impossible—" For the first time, a true惊怒 appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice.

"Nothing is impossible." Chen Ji slowly spoke, a faint smile hanging at the corner of his lips. "Didn't the senior say the Tianji Record was waste paper? Yet this waste paper, precisely, rendered the senior's First Prophecy null and void." His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire secret realm. "Today's matter, I, Chen Ji, remember. When I gather the complete Tianji Record—I'll come to seek instruction from the senior again."

The Heavenly Eye fell silent. That giant pupil turned, seemingly re-evaluating this existence it once regarded as an ant. After a long while, a cold harrumph came from the depths of the azure dome: "Interesting. In ten thousand years, you're the first to dare speak such words before me." The giant eye began to slowly dissipate, yet that voice rang out again. "Chen Ji, remember today's appointment. Next time we meet—I will personally come to take your life."

As the Heavenly Eye dissipated, the elemental energy within the secret realm gradually returned to normal. Chen Ji let out a long breath, his knees softening as he nearly collapsed—that battle just now had consumed more Heavenly Fate than he had accumulated over all these days. But fortunately... he won. Though only a projection. Though only the First Prophecy. But—he won.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing收起 her Demonic Path mist, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying more complex emotions. "Do you know what you just did?" She approached a few steps, voice lowered several degrees. "That was the Heavenly Eye—the existence that, according to legend, only generations of ascension candidates could contact. You, an Outer Disciple/Servant at Foundation Building stage, actually dared—" She paused, finally just shaking her head. "Madman."

Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, her gaze tightly fixed on Chen Ji, seemingly trying to discern something from his face. "Chen Ji, how many things are you still hiding from me?" Her voice remained cold, yet a trace of imperceptible worry hid in her eyes. "The Tianji Record, Fifth Layer awakening, and that just now... are you really just an Outer Disciple/Servant?"

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, meeting Su Qingyao's scrutinizing gaze, a bitter smile tugging at his lips. "Su Senior Sister, some things I temporarily cannot explain." His voice was calm yet firm. "But I can assure you—no matter who I am, no matter what secrets I hold, I will never harm Tianqing Sect." He paused. "Never harm you."

Just then, a brilliant light suddenly erupted at the secret realm entrance. All three turned simultaneously. Countless sealing patterns on that ancient secret realm gate were slowly崩解. A虚拟的书页 flew out from the gate, directly entering Chen Ji's Brow Center—that was the phenomenon following the Tianji Record Fourth Layer seal's解除, and also the reward Mo Xiansheng promised him.

Vast amounts of information exploded in Chen Ji's mind. The Fourth Layer's content was not a combat or foresight-type ability, but a truth sealed for ten thousand years—about the Tianji Record's origin, about the First Generation Prophet's fall, and more critically... about how to completely break free from the Heavenly Eye's control. After reading it, Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is." Chen Ji低声呢喃, his voice carrying a hint of恍然. "So the key to breaking the chess game doesn't lie in opposing Heaven..." He raised his head, his gaze profound as an abyss. "But in—finding all the Tianji Record fragments, and reassembling them into the complete Tianji Record." Only the complete one could completely break free from Heaven's control, becoming the true—artifact to逆天改命.

text.content: Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged a glance, both seeing the same疑惑 in each other's eyes. But they tacitly chose not to pursue—the question—Chen Ji had already said he would protect Tianqing Sect and protect them, that was enough. As for those secrets... they were willing to wait, waiting for the day he was willing to speak.

The phenomenon at the secret realm entrance gradually faded. Chen Ji stood in place, feeling the surging power within his body. The Tianji Record Fourth Layer's unsealing elevated his perception of Heavenly Secrets by an entire level, while the Fifth Layer's awakened 'Heavenly Fate Reversal' ability gave him another trump card in his game against Heaven. This battle, he won very narrowly, but also very beautifully.

After the Heavenly Eye dissipated, the lingering resonance still echoed in the sky. Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at that苍穹 gradually clearing. He记下了, today's debt, he记下了. Heaven wanted his life? Then come try—let's see finally who takes whose life.
